_comment: Tier-2 for skfem poisson#6: the get_quadrature order ceilings and their three DISTINCT messages, all measured on skfem 12.0.1. Triangle order 19 works (73 points, weights summing to 1/2) and 20 raises with the typo'd 'The requested order of quadratureis not implemented!'; tetrahedron order 9 works (45 points, weights summing to 1/6 -- the ceiling is 9, not 8) and 10 raises the correctly-spaced 'The requested order of quadrature is not available.'; and passing the STRING 'triangle' instead of a Refdom class raises a third, easily confused message.
